test_title: PYST 7:SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On:17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The patient found the doctor to be __obtuse__ and distracted by constant calls on his phone.
solution: The correct answer is: **astute** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Obtuse **means stupid and slow to understand, or unwilling to try to understand. (मूर्ख और समझने में धीमा, या समझने की कोशिश करने में अनिच्छुक) • **For example- ***Some of the lyrics of this song are a bit obtuse.* • Marked option **Astute **means very clever; good at judging people or situations. (चतुर व होशियार, सयाना; व्‍यक्तियों या स्थितियों को परखने में कुशल) • **For example- ***He made a series of astute business decisions.* • So, it is clear that the most appropriate **antonym **for 'Obtuse' is 'Astute.' Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • **Obese **means very fat or overweight and is unrelated to the meaning of obtuse. (बहुत मोटा या अधिक वजन वाला) • **Banal **means lacking in originality, boring, or uninteresting, and is also unrelated to the meaning of obtuse. (मौलिकता का अभाव, उबाऊ, या अरुचिकर) • **Obsolete **means no longer in use or outdated, which is again unrelated to the meaning of obtuse. (अब उपयोग में नहीं है या पुराना हो गया है) 3f:Tb31, The correct answer is: "**that he raised many questions**."
